title: The Slow Weather
author: Astrid Delacroix
blurb: Ulyana Ishikawa, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
